g.text: Serve Qwen on the Mac Studio
Fix the flaky checkout e2e test
Speed up the Docker CI build
The Qwen 3.8 27B fine-tune finished on gpu-server. Get it running on the Mac Studio, as fast
as it can go without losing quality.
run mac-studio sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string; sysctl -n hw.memsize | awk '{print $1/2^30…
The bf16 weights are 55 GB. That leaves little room for the KV cache on a 96 GB Mac, so I will
copy them over and quantize them with MLX.
[INFO] Quantized model with 4.501 bits per weight.
31 tokens/s at 16 GB. Now the quality check against the bf16 score from gpu-server.

text.tspan: The fine-tune runs on the Mac Studio at 31 tokens/s.
I quantized it to 4 bit with MLX.
16.4 GB peak, down from 55 GB in bf16.
86.1% on the ticket eval. bf16 gets 86.8%.

g.text: 6 bit would close most of the 0.7 point gap for about 7 GB more memory. Tell me if you want it.
